#model

```{r}
#imputation??
# Function to calculate mode
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# Copy your dataset (so you don't overwrite original)
imputed_df <- clean_df

# Loop through each column
for (col in names(imputed_df)) {
  
  # If numeric → mean imputation
  if (is.numeric(imputed_df[[col]])) {
    mean_val <- mean(imputed_df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    imputed_df[[col]][is.na(imputed_df[[col]])] <- mean_val
  }
  
  # If factor or character → mode imputation
  else if (is.factor(imputed_df[[col]]) || is.character(imputed_df[[col]])) {
    mode_val <- get_mode(imputed_df[[col]])
    imputed_df[[col]][is.na(imputed_df[[col]])] <- mode_val
    
    # Optional: convert character → factor (helps with glm)
    if (is.character(imputed_df[[col]])) {
      imputed_df[[col]] <- as.factor(imputed_df[[col]])
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# propensity score model 
prop_score_mod <- glm(insecticide ~ pulse_avg + 
      gender + 
      age_years + 
      race_ethnicity_detailed + 
      active_duty_military + 
      education_level + 
      marital_status + 
      household_size + 
      income_poverty_ratio + 
      diabetes_diagnosed + 
      sedentary_minutes + 
      sleep_hours_weekday + 
      smoked_100_cigs + 
      height_inches + 
      weight_pounds + 
      mod_activity_per_week, data = clean_df, family = binomial,
      x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
```

```{r}
summary(prop_score_mod)
```

```{r}
Z = prop_score_mod$y
logitps = predict(prop_score_mod)
length(logitps)
```


```{r}
#clean_df
#logitps
```

```{r}
plot(density(logitps[Z]), col = "red", xlim = c(0,1) , main = "Density Estimates of Propensity Scores")
lines(density(logitps[!Z]))
legend("topleft", c("Treated", "Control"), col = c("red", "black"), lty = c(1,1))
```


```{r}
covariates <- c(
    "pulse_avg",
    "gender",
    "age_years",
    "race_ethnicity_detailed",
    "active_duty_military",
    "education_level",
    "marital_status",
    "household_size",
    "income_poverty_ratio",
    "diabetes_diagnosed",
    "sedentary_minutes",
    "sleep_hours_weekday",
    "smoked_100_cigs",
    "height_inches",
    "weight_pounds",
    "mod_activity_per_week"
  )
  
treated <- clean_df[clean_df$insecticide == TRUE, c(covariates, "insecticide")]
control <- clean_df[clean_df$insecticide == FALSE, c(covariates, "insecticide")]
```

```{r}
treated_prop_scores <- predict(prop_score_mod, treated, type = "response")
hist(treated_prop_scores)

control_prop_scores <- predict(prop_score_mod, control, type = "response")
hist(control_prop_scores)
```


```{r}
#regular prop score model, impute predicted prop scores for dist mat: 

treated_imp <- imputed_df[imputed_df$insecticide == TRUE, c(covariates, "insecticide")]
control_imp <- imputed_df[imputed_df$insecticide == FALSE, c(covariates, "insecticide")]
```

```{r}
treated_prop_scores_imp <- predict(prop_score_mod, treated_imp, type = "response")
hist(treated_prop_scores_imp)

control_prop_scores_imp <- predict(prop_score_mod, control_imp, type = "response")
hist(control_prop_scores_imp)
```

```{r}
range(treated_prop_scores_imp)
range(control_prop_scores_imp)
```

```{r}
# report the fraction of treated and control individuals that
# have an estimated propensity score below 0.0001

cat("Treated Proportion with Propensity Scores < 0.0001", mean(treated_prop_scores_imp < 0.0001), "\n")
cat("Control Proportion with Propensity Scores < 0.0001",  mean(control_prop_scores_imp < 0.0001))
```


#distmat

```{r}
distmat.logitps = outer(logitps[Z == 1],logitps[Z==0],"-")
distmat.logitps = abs(distmat.logitps)

rownames(distmat.logitps)= complete_cases_df$subject_ID[Z == 1]
colnames(distmat.logitps)= complete_cases_df$subject_ID[Z == 0]
```
